title: Transforming education with AI, built on global standards
lead: Wicked Storm builds up learning data using 1EdTech global standards and adds AI on top to support AX (AI transformation) in education. We also apply AI to our own work first, with our in-house LLM Wiki.

wiki.title: LLM Wiki: scattered knowledge in one place
wiki.lead: We gather documents, discussions, and answers to recurring questions into our LLM Wiki, and build AI into our workflows to refine the way we work.

map.label: Knowledge map: scattered documents, discussions, and recurring questions are woven into concepts (products, technology, standards, projects, certifications) and their relationships; AI finds materials along the link between standards and projects

screen.label: LLM Wiki example screen
screen.title: LLM Wiki
screen.a: It is used to exchange curricula, achievement standards, and competencies as one standard framework. Collected learning data points to items in that framework.

steps.title: Gather
steps.text: Documents, discussions, and answers to recurring questions that used to be scattered are kept in one place.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Documents and discussions are woven into concepts and relationships (an ontology), so anyone can ask for and find the knowledge they need.

steps.title: Draft, then decide
steps.text: AI finds and gathers relevant materials and creates a draft; the person in charge then reviews, edits, and finalizes it.

wiki.ruleLabel: The same principle as our products
wiki.rule: AI finds, organizes, and drafts. People decide what to use and how.

ax.title: Education AX: from management to experience
ax.lead: We help learning platforms move from tools for managing learning to spaces for experiencing it. All learning activity is collected as learning data built on global standards, and AI analyzes it to suggest what administrators, instructors, and learners do next.

steps.title: Collect
steps.text: Collects and stores learning activity as learning data using global standards (xAPI · 1EdTech Caliper) and links it to 1EdTech CASE frameworks.

claims.text: AI finds anomaly signals in learning data,
and profiles learners with an LLM.

steps.title: Suggest
steps.text: On a teaching and learning platform where people interact with AI, it suggests next steps to administrators, instructors, and learners.

steps.title: Next semester
steps.text: People judge and apply. The results build up again as learning data and inform next semester’s learning design.

std.title: 1EdTech standards
std.lead: 1EdTech is the global consortium that develops EdTech standards (formerly IMS Global). Wicked Storm is a founding board member of 1EdTech Korea and is active as a 1EdTech Contributing Member.
